rules.order: ascending SHA-256 of '<seed>:<base>:<kind>:<id>', the kind being 'document' or 'question'; nothing else is drawn
rules.conditionalqa: the documents that carry a question, in the order, are cut into three runs whose sizes differ by one at most, an earlier run the larger: tuning, locked, reserve; a question stands in the part of its document, a not-answerable one too; inside a part the questions stand by document, and those of one document by the order
rules.wixqa: locked is every ExpertWritten question; tuning is the Simulated questions that share no gold article with a locked one; excluded is the Simulated questions that do; each part in the order; there is no reserve
rules.multihoprag: advisory is the questions of the types inference_query and null_query, in the order; nothing is locked; the other types stand in no part
rules.strata: ConditionalQA: primary - an answerable question with an evidence group and no unresolved evidence, the denominator of all_evidence_coverage; several_sections - a primary question whose evidence cannot be placed in one section of its page; a not-answerable question stands outside both. WixQA and MultiHop-RAG: the stratum the case carries
rules.clusters: ConditionalQA: the primary questions of one document; WixQA and MultiHop-RAG: the questions joined by a shared gold document, directly or through other questions, counted inside the part or the selection that is read
rules.selection: a prefix of the order of its part, read on the questions of the stratum the rule names, or on all of them when it names none: by documents - the first documents that carry at least the asked number of such questions, and of each its first ones up to that number; by questions - the first such questions of the part
rules.access: open - a development run may read the part; locked - no run reads a question of the part until an entry of 'opened' names it, and acceptance 4.1 alone adds one
